verdict.rationale: Jira's Rovo AI features (task breakdown, automations, trend surfacing) imply some natural-language assistance, and an official Atlassian MCP server exists that would let AI agents translate natural-language requests into Jira actions, but there is no direct documentation or hands-on evidence of a chat-style natural-language command interface within Jira itself. Missing for 10: first-party docs demonstrating actual NL command execution in-product, independent/hands-on confirmation that Rovo AI or MCP-driven commands reliably operate Jira.
